arguments.sql:
SELECT types, COUNT(*) AS card_count,
       SUM(cardKingdomFoilId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL) AS missing_id_count,
       SUM(cardKingdomFoilId = '' OR cardKingdomId = '') AS empty_id_count
FROM main.cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
GROUP BY types
ORDER BY card_count DESC
LIMIT 12;

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM main.cards
WHERE instr(',' || types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId ASC, cardKingdomId ASC
LIMIT 3;
